title: The Long March
tagline: A revolution born in starvation, hardened in philosophy, written in history.

scenes.text: Jiangxi Province, October 1934. Surrounded by Chiang Kai-shek's nationalist forces, 86,000 Communist soldiers begin an impossible retreat — a march of over 9,000 kilometers through mountains, swamps, and hostile territory. Only 8,000 will complete it.

scenes.speaker: Mao Zedong
scenes.text: The revolution has not failed. The revolution is retreating — to regroup, to learn, to grow stronger. From defeat, we draw the lessons that will bring victory. This is not the end. This is the beginning.

challenge.instruction: Mao Zedong: build a truss that holds.
challenge.fact: The Long March (1934–35) covered about 9,000 km — crossing 18 mountain ranges and 24 rivers. Of the 80,000 who began, fewer than 10,000 completed it. It transformed apparent defeat into the founding myth of Communist China.

scenes.text: The Long March became the founding myth of Chinese Communist power. Those who completed it became an elite — the hardened core around which the People's Republic would be built fifteen years later.

challenge.fact: The Long March was a 9,000 km strategic retreat that repositioned the Red Army — transforming apparent defeat into the foundation of eventual victory.

scenes.speaker: Mao Zedong
scenes.text: China is like a blank sheet of paper. It is possible to write the most beautiful characters on blank paper. The old China — feudal, exploited, humiliated — must be swept clean before the new one can be written.

challenge.instruction: Mao Zedong: clear the field without a blast.
challenge.fact: The most decisive battle of the Long March was the crossing of the Luding Bridge — a chain bridge over a gorge, its planks removed, defended by machine guns. Communist soldiers crawled across the chains under fire.

scenes.text: The Long March route wound through the most treacherous terrain in China. Navigate the mountain passes to reach the safety of Yan'an...

challenge.instruction: Mao Zedong: mix the right measures.
challenge.fact: When the Long March began in October 1934, approximately 86,000 soldiers set out. Fewer than 8,000 reached Yan'an in October 1935 — a loss of over 90%. Mao Zedong transformed this catastrophic retreat into a founding myth of Communist China, portraying it as proof of revolutionary will and endurance.

scenes.speaker: Mao Zedong
scenes.text: This time the whole board is judged at once. Deploy Andrew Mellon, Coco Chanel and me, turn us public, then declare the International Conference: the highest public Politics on the board when the round ends takes the prize.

challenge.instruction: Fight lesson 6 · Global Competition. Deploy your Great People, Toggle Public on each, then start the International Conference and End Turn to win the round with the highest public Politics on the board.
challenge.fact: A Global Competition counts every public Great Person on the whole board; followers and face-down cards add nothing. It lasts one round, and the strongest player draws a reward: event cards, followers or a new Great Person.
